purpose: Remove the compact source-offset replay spill cliff with stable bounded normalized-ID grouping and sequential alias/source-lane cursors.

implementation.normalization: Term counts and source geometry are collected during spool append. Stable term IDs remain available through preparation; offset grouping does not hash token text again.
implementation.memory_path: Direct immutable source bytes and compact occurrence links; no owning occurrence-token array.
implementation.disk_path: Stable MSD partitioning on lexical term ranks, sixteen buffers in one private run per level. Counting-scatter leaves are bounded by 16384 records and live headroom. A single oversized term streams directly. Maximum radix depth follows 32-bit IDs.
implementation.replay: Source-order and alias cursors read bounded sequential blocks. The final alias releases original replay ownership. Partitioned term runs are consumed in lexical order and close after shared-codec encoding.
implementation.resources: Temporary buffers use refundable scratch without bypassing parent quotas. Existing private-run file/disk reservations and failure teardown remain authoritative.
implementation.format: One persisted-byte encoder consumes materialized or normalized preparation. Exact order, positions, byte spans, source lanes, geometry and Snappy bytes match.

methodology.scope: Supported optimized native source-capture kernel, plus independent Debug native postings/search and real Parquet/Iceberg E2E correctness qualification. No whole-ingestion speedup is inferred.
methodology.baseline: Frozen source-capture probe from qualification ebd79013e3c088d3639a8f1acb21f18db68fae6a (runtime 3d058bc003189c73b49f190fdf17ecea423d67ac), already including main 97945ad58e8194815ad377a0ba853a4583d83ec4. The new harness only adds a physical-read counter; timed work, fixture generation, quotas and equivalence checks remain comparable.
methodology.cohorts: 65536 repeats fit the 4-MiB compact record prefix exactly; 65537 repeats spill; 131072 repeats exercise a larger spilled run. English/simple diverse two-binding, English diverse single-binding, and English repeated two-binding cohorts use identical 512-MiB quotas.
methodology.pairing: One excluded warmup and three alternating measured pairs per version/control/cohort. Final measurements overlap no task-owned builds, tests or cleanup. Other host activity and OS caches remain uncontrolled.
methodology.timing: Analysis, consumer callbacks, source-offset encoding and temporary teardown are included. Input generation, fingerprint setup, startup, final encoded-output verification and Capture teardown are excluded. Callbacks are not full postings construction.
methodology.equivalence: Every input SHA-256, token/span digest and complete encoded SHA-256 matches across both versions and both representations in every cohort. Every alias receives the same ordered stream.
methodology.memory: Tracked allocation peaks exclude immutable input and are not peak RSS. Quotas do not change within comparisons.
methodology.reads: replay_reads counts physical reads from the original private spool, final grouping run and retired partition runs for two-binding compact capture. It is null for controls without this counter. It is not a network or total-byte measurement.
methodology.capacity_controls: At 64 MiB, owning-token English controls are expected to fail OutOfMemory while compact capture must complete with identical output; these negative controls are separate from product regression tests.

limitations: These kernel results do not establish optimized-server throughput, complete ingestion/publication latency, cold-storage, archive-scale, cloud or RSS gains.
Compact replay retains a memory/CPU tradeoff versus owning tokens; compare the candidate control and both sides of the disk threshold, not only the former 7x cliff.
Earlier spill/cache observations retain their own source and binary identities. Current work does not change those kernels.
Real-provider retention qualification remains deferred; the external 142577-row HN fixture is unavailable here; a full WASM bundle remains unqualified. Memory-only Run interfaces remain portable.
